headline: EAGLE LANDS ON MOON; ARMSTRONG AND ALDRIN TOUCH DOWN ON SEA OF TRANQUILITY
dispatch: The Apollo 11 lunar module Eagle touched down on the Moon's Sea of Tranquility at 4:17 p.m. Eastern time on July 20, 1969, with astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin aboard. Commander Armstrong reported that the Eagle had landed after guiding the craft past a boulder-strewn crater with less than thirty seconds of fuel remaining. Michael Collins orbited overhead in the command module Columbia while his crewmates prepared for the first human steps on the lunar surface.
answer: Eagle lands on the Moon's Sea of Tranquility, 1969
